title: Benchmarking Quantum Feature Encoding Strategies for Binary Classification with QSVM
summary: The way in which classical data are encoded into quantum states plays a significant role in both classification performance and quantum circuit complexity in Quantum Machine Learning. In this study, the effects of different quantum feature encoding strategies on Quantum Support Vector Machine performance were investigated using five binary classification datasets. In particular, the statistical relationships between features were incorporated into quantum circuits through \(RY(θ)\) and controlled-\(RY(θ)\) gates, and this approach was compared with conventional quantum feature maps.
